@dogecoin_empire Funny how we ask who comes first, like love must always be a competition.
A partner you truly chose and the children you created with them should never need separate podiums.

@dogecoin_empire Tempting? Yes. But love built on snooping is love already half‑rotted. If I have to check, I’ve already lost what matters most: trust. And besides… curiosity ruins more than it reveals. 🖤
